scope: Gated shared core, individual focused scenarios only. No aggregate validation or admission.
staging: Real immutable typed creature/program bodies; paired complete flags remain false. Explicitly seeded physical gated fixtures use ordinary paid actions but are not accepted legal-deck games.

core.current_cast_target_kinds: CastTarget::PermanentKinds queries current exact expected battlefield target; no target LKI per CR115.9b.
core.delayed_source_power: DelayedSpellCastSourcePower is a stored-only callback, not a passive battlefield observer. Registered CopyNextInstantSorcery checks signed current source power or latest-departure DamageFacts.power against qualifying cast mana value. Other delayed callbacks retain their old behavior.
core.optional_cast_retarget: ChangeCastSpellTargets captures exact existing CastPaymentEvent.stack_id, keeps the original spell controller and allocations, and privately distinguishes optional unchanged targets from mandatory Bolt Bend changes. No new public field.

primary_sources.snapshot_note: Full Rust snapshots are retained; targeted runtime functions and complete owned definitions were read, not every unrelated function in each broad module.
primary_sources.discrepancy: Java TargetsPermanentPredicate accepts departed target LKI; contextual cast-target qualification follows CR115.9b and ignores a departed target.

focused_test.earlier_attempts: focus1 did not compile due test assertion method; focus2 six fixture failures, focus3 one fixture lookup failure. Those reports remain failures and are preserved.
focused_test.privacy_atomicity_ownership: Paid action helpers check wrong actor, owned raw/index equality and restore. Explicit orphan checks drop parent, compare full both-seat observations, reject stale indices and restore/replay. Invalid retargets compare snapshot, owned bytes and both observations.
focused_test.bounded_cases: Physical hand seeding for three gated definitions; departed-target predicate and physical graveyard-to-hand return are explicitly bounded core checks. No unsupported producer behavior is claimed.

deferred: No full native, full old trace export, aggregate static checks, release or CI executed for this checkpoint. Full-card matrix and admissions remain pending; all aggregate work deferred until final full-set integration.
